blocks.x: What Compliance, Audit & Digital Trust means at Dataq Software: the scope we sign, the architecture we ship, the evidence generated in-flight, and the per workflow outcomes measured against your audited baseline.

The design principle here is simple: evidence is captured where the work happens, not reconstructed later in Compliance, Audit & Digital Trust, and rollback is rehearsed before go-live rather than after the incident. The engineering bet is explicit: the decision path and the audit path share one timeline across the Compliance, Audit & Digital Trust estate, so a regression is a cohort, never an estate.
